note: Open evidence questions. A gap records what this registry establishes and what it does not; it is a limit of the registry's coverage, not a finding that something does not exist. Each gap stores the records it was assessed against and a digest of the data it rests on: when that data changes (a new or edited record, a changed stage, attribute or relationship), the build fails until the gap is re-assessed. Checks are re-run on every build against the canonical data.
open_wording: No qualifying evidence is currently recorded in this registry.

gaps.question: What documents actual use, adoption, accuracy, service outcomes or sustained operation of Idarati AI?

established.text: The ministry presented Idarati AI as an agentic AI assistant for administrative procedures.
It was publicly available on the ministry's own services on 18 October 2026, and answered a test question through its public interface.

gaps.unestablished: How many people use it, its accuracy, its effect on administrative services, and whether it has operated continuously. Public availability on one date does not establish any of these.
evidence_needed: An operator's report of use (annual report, parliamentary answer, published usage statistics)
An independent evaluation of the service

gaps.question: What publicly documented measurements show progress toward the official targets of Morocco AI 2030?

established.text: The roadmap sets three 2030 targets: MAD 100 billion in added value to GDP, 50,000 direct and indirect jobs, and 200,000 trained and certified AI talents.

The ministry's September 2026 presentation of the roadmap's "main advances" restated the targets and listed items presented (the AI marketplace, Idarati AI, a proof of concept of a national meta-application and e-wallet), without quantified progress towards the targets.
Two projects are recorded as included in the roadmap, on the basis of that presentation.

gaps.unestablished: Any measured progress towards the value-added, jobs or talent targets. A project's status is not a measure of progress towards them.
evidence_needed: Official indicator reporting on the targets (ministry progress report, budget documents, national statistics)

gaps.question: What independently documents AI workloads on the Toubkal supercomputer, and at what scale?

established.text: Toubkal is listed in the June 2026 TOP500 as general-purpose high-performance computing; the listing documents capacity, not workloads or users.

A peer-reviewed article by authors affiliated with its host university states that large-language-model fine-tuning has been run on it, and presents as a benchmark the runs that produced the GemMaroc Moroccan Darija models (attributed to Belkasmi et al.).

gaps.unestablished: Independent documentation of AI workloads on Toubkal, and the scale, share, users or continuity of AI use. This is not a finding that Toubkal is not used for AI: its operator's own authors report specific fine-tuning runs. What is missing is independent and quantified documentation.
evidence_needed: The GemMaroc study by Belkasmi et al., which the article cites, if it documents its use of Toubkal
Independent publications acknowledging Toubkal for specific AI models

gaps.question: Which announced or signed computing and data-centre initiatives have verifiable construction, commissioning or operation?

established.text: Agreements on green data-centre infrastructure and on a data-centre partnership with UM6P were signed at the First National AI Conference.
A memorandum on the Nexus AI Factory is reported by the press only.

gaps.unestablished: Construction, commissioning or operation of any of these facilities.
evidence_needed: Operator or independent confirmation that a facility is built and running

gaps.question: Which relationships asserting a formal act (a signature, creation, designation, investment, development or operation) rest only on announcements, news reports or descriptions in this registry?
gaps.unestablished: The instrument or formal record behind each relationship listed below: the signed text, founding act, designation, investment or operating record. This measures how each relationship is documented in this registry, not whether it is true: an official report of a signing is good evidence that a signing was announced, not of what the instrument says.
evidence_needed: Published texts of the conventions and memoranda
